_about: Disclosure files for the case studies; same format as data/disclosures/manifest.json (see data/disclosures/README.md). Empty until the files in docs/case_studies.md are downloaded.

files.notes: Quarterly shareholding-pattern XBRL, original filing of each quarter, disclosure_date = NSE broadcast date. The pledged_* columns hold shares 'pledged or otherwise encumbered' (pledges and non-disposal undertakings together: the only measure filed before mid-2025), an upper bound on pledges. Built by scripts/build_case_disclosures.py from data/disclosures/history/shareholding_2021_2024.csv.
